```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Importing the dataset for analysis
metabric <- read_csv("Breast Cancer METABRIC.csv")

colnames(metabric)

```

```{r}
# Inspecting the structure of our dataset
str(metabric)

# Quick summary of the dataset
summary(metabric)
```

```{r}
# Cleaning my dataset for analysis
metabric_clean <- metabric %>%
  rename(
    time_raw = `Overall Survival (Months)`,
    status_raw = `Overall Survival Status`,
    age = `Age at Diagnosis`,
    stage = `Tumor Stage`,
    size = `Tumor Size`,
    grade = `Neoplasm Histologic Grade`,
    ER = `ER Status`,
    PR = `PR Status`,
    HER2 = `HER2 Status`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(time_raw),
    !is.na(status_raw),
    !is.na(stage),
    time_raw > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = time_raw,
    event = ifelse(status_raw == "Deceased", 1, 0),
    stage = factor(stage),
    grade = factor(grade),
    ER = factor(ER),
    PR = factor(PR),
    HER2 = factor(HER2)
  ) %>%
  select(time, event, age, stage, size, grade, ER, PR, HER2)

dim(metabric_clean)
table(metabric_clean$event)
table(metabric_clean$stage, useNA = "always")

```

```{r}
# Overall Kaplan-Meier
km_overall <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = metabric_clean)

ggsurvplot(
  km_overall,
  data = metabric_clean,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  tables.theme = theme_cleantable(),
  xlab = "Time (Months)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Overall Survival",
  ggtheme = theme_bw(),
  tables.ggtheme = theme_bw()
)

```

```{r}
# Stage-specific Kaplan-Meier

metabric_stage <- metabric_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(stage), stage != "0") %>%  
  mutate(stage = droplevels(stage))        

table(metabric_stage$stage)

km_stage <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ stage, data = metabric_stage)
  
ggsurvplot(km_stage,
           data = metabric_stage,
           conf.int = TRUE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           risk.table.y.text = FALSE,  
           risk.table.height = 0.25,   
           tables.theme = theme_cleantable(),  
           pval = TRUE,
           pval.coord = c(200, 0.1),   
           legend.title = "Tumor Stage",
           legend.labs = c("Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV"),
           xlab = "Time (Months)",
           ylab = "Survival Probability",
           title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival by Tumor Stage",
           ggtheme = theme_bw(),       
           tables.ggtheme = theme_bw())
```

```{r}
# Running a Cox PH model with key clinical predictors
cox_model <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ age + stage + size + grade + ER + PR + HER2,
                   data = metabric_clean)

summary(cox_model)
```

```{r}
# Visualizing the Cox model results
metabric_clean_df <- as.data.frame(metabric_clean)

ggforest(cox_model, data = metabric_clean_df)
```

```{r}
# Testing proportional hazards assumption
cox_zph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model)
print(cox_zph_test)  # Smaller p-values suggest evidence against PH

# Ploting residuals (straight lines = assumption holds)
plot(cox_zph_test, 
     main = "Scaled Schoenfeld Residuals",
     xlab = "Transformed Time")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# Revised Cox model to address PH violation and the following was done:
# - stage was handled with stratification
# - age was handled as a time-dependent covariate
cox_revised <- coxph(
  Surv(time, event) ~ age + tt(age) + size + grade + ER + PR + HER2 + strata(stage),
  data = metabric_clean,
  tt = function(x, t, ...) x * log(t + 1)
)

summary(cox_revised)

# Note:
# cox.zph() is not used on cox_revised because models with tt() terms
# are not compatible with the standard Schoenfeld residual test
```
